backstory.title: Investigator Backstory
backstory.keeperNoteBody: In Call of Cthulhu, backstory elements often become central to the narrative. The Keeper can use important people, significant places, or treasured possessions as narrative hooks. Phobias and manias can be acquired during play through traumatic sanity loss. Encounters with strange entities can haunt investigators throughout the campaign.
